title: The S and ST fixed-point counts
statement: For every nonzero natural number N, let Γ₀(N) be the subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) whose bottom-left entry is zero modulo N, and let Q=SL₂(ℤ)/Γ₀(N) with left multiplication. Put S=((0,−1),(1,0)) and T=((1,1),(0,1)). The number of q∈Q fixed by S is #{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+1=0}=ModularCurve.nuTwo N, and the number fixed by ST is #{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+x+1=0}=ModularCurve.nuThree N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Nat.card {q : Q // ModularGroup.S • q = q} = ModularCurve.nuTwo N ∧ Nat.card {q : Q // (ModularGroup.S * ModularGroup.T) • q = q} = ModularCurve.nuThree N
